content.title: Paper Craft Stop-Motion Explainer
content.summary: Use layered paper sculpture, paper puppets, and mechanical papercraft movement to explain a process clearly. The Seedance companion locks layered depth, visible physical mechanisms, restrained camera work, and tactile sound.

quick_start.input_format: Topic or process + layered paper setting + paper puppet roles + visible mechanical steps + restrained camera plan + tactile sound family
quick_start.recommended_input: Use layered paper sculpture, paper puppets, and mechanical papercraft movement to explain a process clearly; the Seedance companion locks layered depth, visible physical mechanisms, restrained camerawork, and tactile sound.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Use layered paper sculpture, paper puppets, and mechanical papercraft movement to explain a process clearly; the Seedance companion locks layered depth, visible physical mechanisms, restrained camerawork, and tactile sound.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.
